Started the day with an important meeting where the National Government (DPWH) and the Local Government of Quezon City agreed on the appropriate course of action to manage flooding in the area where Matalahib Creek meets the San Juan River. The decision was reached after consultations with UP RI-NOAH (popularly known as Project NOAH) and stakeholders.
